display.title: Bitachon and the Alter Rebbe's Wedding Rescue
display.summary_short: A Motzaei Shabbos talk at a wedding celebration: the seven ingredients of true bitachon, and how the Alter Rebbe's warm smile opened a miser's heart to free a captured groom.
display.summary_long: Recorded at a Melave Malka celebrating a new couple, during the Corona pandemic and the week of the Alter Rebbe's yahrzeit. The speaker explains how Chassidus changes the way we see a world that seems out of control. The Rebbe asked children why a drop of water gets the brachah 'Shehakol', which speaks of the whole universe. Then come the Chovos HaLevavos's seven conditions for trusting someone, which only Hashem fulfils, and the Rebbe's teaching that trust, unlike belief, changes how we live, with his encouragement to study Shaar HaBitachon. The story: the Alter Rebbe arranges a match between two orphans, but on the wedding day a Jew-hating police chief seizes the groom for the army and demands 1,500 rubles. The town is poor; the only rich man is known as a miser. The Alter Rebbe accepts his single rusty coin with a sincere smile and blessing, and the man breaks down, tells why he stopped giving, and pays the whole sum. The wedding goes ahead, and the money returns to the couple in a surprising way. The lesson: look at every Jew, our children and ourselves with a good eye.
display.lesson: Trust Hashem completely, and look at every Jew with a good eye, seeing what he does rather than what he lacks.

date.note: Motzaei Shabbos 'coming from the Alter Rebbe's yahrzeit', this week's Likkutei Sichos on Shemos, and a new Corona strain: fits 24 Teves 5781 (Friday) and Shabbos Shemos 9 Jan 2021.
